items.q: We send only a domain to check it — never your full URLs or page content. Privacy is the architecture, not a marketing checkbox.
We publish our phishing-detection rate every week — the exact script, the exact dataset, side by side with Cloudflare and Google. Measured, not marketed.
Core link-blocking is free forever. We only charge for extras like family protection and detailed explanations — never for the protection itself.

items.a: История просмотров никогда не покидает ваше устройство. На наших серверах хранится только email и статус подписки. Даже если нас взломают, злоумышленники ничего не узнают о вашей активности в интернете.
Нет. Большинство доменов проверяется мгновенно по локальному списку. На наш API отправляются только неизвестные домены, и только их имя — никогда не полный URL.
Да! На мобильных устройствах Cleanway автоматически определяет VPN и переключается в режим DNS, работая вместе с NordVPN, ExpressVPN или любым другим провайдером.

items.q: Чем отличается от Google Safe Browsing?
items.a: Google Safe Browsing работает реактивно: ловит известные угрозы, но пропускает новый фишинг. Cleanway добавляет ML-детекцию, ещё около 15 источников данных об угрозах, аудит приватности — и не отправляет историю ваших просмотров в Google.

Да! Бесплатный план включает 10 API-проверок в день для неизвестных доменов, неограниченные мгновенные проверки по локальному списку и базовый Privacy Audit. Большинству обычных пользователей апгрейд не нужен.

dns.ios_step1: Нажмите «Разрешить», когда iOS предложит загрузить профиль.

dns.android_intro: В Android 9 (Pie) и выше DNS-over-TLS встроен — приложение не нужно.
dns.android_step1: Откройте Настройки → Сеть и интернет → Частный DNS-сервер.
dns.android_compat_note: На некоторых Samsung и Xiaomi эта опция спрятана в разделе Подключения → Другие настройки подключения. Если не находите — поищите «Частный DNS» в Настройках.
dns.win_intro: Windows 11 поддерживает DNS-over-HTTPS из коробки. Более ранним версиям Windows понадобится сторонний инструмент вроде Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 — увы.
dns.win_step1: Откройте Параметры → Сеть и интернет → Wi-Fi → нажмите свою сеть → Назначение DNS-сервера → Изменить.
dns.win_step2: Переключитесь на «Вручную», включите IPv4, укажите предпочитаемый DNS 1.1.1.1, а для DNS over HTTPS выберите «Вкл. (шаблон вручную)».
dns.benefit_1: Фишинговые ссылки из SMS, почты и Telegram открываются как «сайт не найден» вместо страницы, ворующей пароли.
dns.benefit_2: Управляющие серверы вредоносного ПО не могут достучаться до вашего устройства — даже если сомнительное приложение пытается «позвонить домой».
dns.benefit_3: Домены, маскирующиеся под бренды (paypal-secure-login.com), блокируются прямо на уровне резолвера — браузер даже не начинает их загружать.
dns.benefit_4: Работает в любом приложении, не только в браузере. Ссылки в WhatsApp, банковские приложения, встроенные браузеры — всё под защитой.
dns.privacy_heading: Приватность — что мы видим, а что нет
dns.privacy_body: Cleanway DNS только резолвит домен. Мы не пишем запросы на диск, не отправляем их в Sentry, никому не продаём. Запросы лежат в памяти ровно столько, чтобы дать ответ.
dns.privacy_logs: Что мы СОХРАНЯЕМ: анонимный суточный счётчик общего числа запросов и блокировок — для квартального отчёта о прозрачности. Никаких доменов, IP или пользователей.
dns.layer_heading: Where DNS fits in your protection
dns.layer_body: DNS is the widest layer — it protects every app on your device, not just the browser. It is also the shallowest: it can only block a domain that is already on our phishing blocklist. It cannot read a page, so on its own it will not catch a brand-new phishing kit the moment it appears, or a credential form hiding on a trusted-but-hacked site.
dns.layer_extension: For that deeper protection, add the Cleanway browser extension. It runs the full per-page analysis on every site you open, spots look-alike login forms in real time, and warns you before you type a password. DNS covers the widest surface; the extension adds the deepest checks — together they cover both.
dns.layer_generic: This is not a generic DNS filter. Cleanway DNS is tuned specifically for phishing and credential theft, driven by the same threat intelligence that powers the extension — not a repurposed ad-blocking list.

methodology.page_description: Cleanway's per-domain detection results vs Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 for Families, Google Safe Browsing, PhishTank, and VirusTotal — measured weekly on fresh URLhaus + PhishTank URLs. Reproducible benchmark script linked.
methodology.hero_title: How we measure our own detection rate
methodology.hero_subtitle: Every recall number we publish points here. The dataset, the script, and a button to clone it on GitHub.
methodology.why_p1: Every other anti-phishing vendor publishes glossy quarterly threat reports without their false-positive rate or per-vendor recall comparison. The numbers exist only in their internal dashboards.
methodology.why_p2: We do the opposite: this page runs the same Python script anyone can clone, every Monday, against fresh URLhaus + PhishTank phishing URLs, and publishes the raw results. The script's output IS the marketing claim.
methodology.results_unavailable: Latest benchmark snapshot not available — re-running cron now.
methodology.results_meta: Snapshot: $DATE$. Sample: $PHISHING$ phishing URLs, $LEGIT$ Tranco legit URLs.
methodology.safe_table_heading: Legit batch (FPR — false-positive rate, expected verdict: safe)
methodology.verdict_mapping_heading: How we map each resolver's response
methodology.verdict_mapping_p1: Different vendors return different verdict shapes. We normalise to three: dangerous / safe / unknown. Unknown verdicts (rate-limited, not indexed, error) are reported separately — not counted as right or wrong.
methodology.reproduce_p1: Two commands and a Python 3 install. The script fetches the same feeds, runs the same comparisons, writes the same JSON output:
methodology.cadence_p1: The benchmark runs every Monday at 05:15 UTC via a GitHub Actions cron. Results commit to docs/benchmarks/ in this repo. A regression-detection step opens a PR if recall drops more than 5 percentage points week-over-week.
methodology.caveat_1: Cleanway uses the public /api/v1/check endpoint — same anonymous surface a regular user would see. We deliberately do NOT use a privileged path for benchmarking ourselves.
methodology.caveat_2: PhishTank's free check API returns 'not indexed' for most fresh URLhaus URLs because their database lags by a few hours — that's why PhishTank's Recall column often shows '—' (unknown), not because it's broken.
methodology.caveat_3: Google Safe Browsing requires an API key (GOOGLE_SAFE_BROWSING_KEY). If unset, that column shows '—' and is excluded from the comparison.
methodology.caveat_4: Latency p50 measured from this script's host (US/EU CI runner); your latency from Asia or LATAM will differ. The relative comparison stays the same.

title.text: Защита от мошенников — настроено для вас

body_p1_to_grandchild.text: $NAME$ настроил(а) на ваших устройствах защиту Cleanway с крупным шрифтом и голосовыми уведомлениями. Вам не нужно ничего делать — всё уже работает.

body_p2_what_it_does.text: Когда мошенник попытается обмануть вас через поддельный сайт банка или уведомление о посылке, Cleanway остановит это до того, как вы что-то введёте. Большими буквами появится предупреждение: «СТОП — это сайт мошенников».

reassurance.text: Если не уверены, что делать, нажмите в приложении кнопку «Позвать семью» — $NAME$ получит сообщение и поможет.

hero.sub_partial: Tap a card below to finish setup

check.title: Check anything
check.desc: Paste a link, scan a QR code, or share anything suspicious straight to Cleanway
check.share_sheet_body: From any app, tap Share, then choose Cleanway. We'll check the link and tell you if it's safe.
check.note: Works with anything you can copy or share — including iMessage.

home.privacy: We check website names on our servers — never your passwords, messages, or browsing history.

network.title: Every app
network.desc: Blocks known scam sites in almost every app — even inside WhatsApp
network.honesty: Can't catch brand-new scam sites, or apps that bring their own private DNS
network.state_paused: Paused. Tap to turn back on.
network.state_unverified: Running, but we could not confirm it is filtering right now.
network.state_blocked: This Wi-Fi needs a sign-in page. Cleanway paused itself and will come back on automatically.

browser.title: Your browser
browser.desc: Checks every page you open and warns you right on the page
browser.honesty: Can't see inside other apps — the Every-app shield covers those

messages.title: Text messages
messages.desc: Moves scam texts (SMS) to Junk before you tap them
messages.honesty: Can't see iMessage — Apple's rule, not ours. It also can't count what it catches, by design.

shield.always_on_hint: Keep it on after restart — turn on Always-on VPN

rollout.network_ios: Blocks scam sites in almost every app. In final testing — not on iPhone yet.
rollout.browser_ios: Warns you right on the page in Safari. Coming next.
rollout.messages_ios: Filters scam texts (SMS). Planned — it will never be able to see iMessage.
rollout.browser_android: Checks links you tap in any app, before they open. Coming next.
rollout.messages_android: Not possible for us on Android yet — sharing a text to Cleanway is the way to check one.

check.title: Check a link
check.subtitle: Paste any link or type a website name
check.placeholder: example.com or paste a full link
check.invalid_title: That doesn't look like a link
check.invalid_body: Type a website name like example.com, or paste the whole link.

scanner.permission_body: Cleanway uses the camera only to read QR codes. Nothing is recorded and no picture is saved.
scanner.permission_blocked_body: Camera access is switched off for Cleanway. Open Settings to switch it back on — the camera is only used to read QR codes.
scanner.instruction: Point the camera at a QR code
scanner.instruction_sub: Hold steady until the code sits inside the frame
scanner.no_link_body: This QR code does not contain a website link, so there is nothing to check.
scanner.privacy: The code is read on your phone. Only the website name is sent to our servers to be checked.

result.low_confidence: Limited analysis — some checks couldn't run
result.privacy: Checked on our servers. Only the website name was sent — nothing else.
result.error_body: The server didn't answer. Check your connection and try again.
result.error_rate_limited: You've checked a lot of links in the last minute. Wait a moment and try again.
result.error_server: Our server had a problem, not your connection. Please try again in a minute.

shared.score_caption: Risk score — higher means more suspicious
shared.advice_safe: We found no problems with this website name.
shared.advice_caution: Something looks off. Don't sign in or pay on this site until you're sure.
shared.advice_dangerous: Don't open this link. Never type your password or card details there.
shared.no_url_body: Nothing came through, or what was shared wasn't a link. Try sharing it again.
shared.check_failed_body: We couldn't reach our servers, so we don't know if this link is safe. Please try again in a moment.

breach.title: Leaked password check
breach.subtitle: Some people use their email address as their password. This tells you if that has already leaked.
breach.scope_note: This is not a full breach report. Listing every breach an address was caught in needs a paid data source we have not connected yet.
breach.found_body: This address has turned up {{times}} times in lists of leaked passwords. If you use it as a password anywhere, change that password now.
breach.clear_body: This address has not turned up as a password in any leak we can see. It may still have been in a breach we cannot check.
breach.error_body: The check did not go through. Please try again in a minute.
breach.how_step_1: Your email is turned into a long code on this phone.
breach.how_step_2: Only the first 5 characters of that code are sent.
breach.how_step_3: The server sends back hundreds of codes that start the same way.
breach.how_step_4: Your phone finds the match on its own.
breach.privacy: Your email address never leaves this phone.

history.score_hint: A higher score means more risk.
history.empty_body: Every link you check shows up here. The list is kept on this phone only.
history.privacy: This list stays on your phone. When you check a link, only the website name is sent to our servers.

report.title: Weekly report
report.summary_note: Counted from the links you checked in this app over the last 7 days.
report.flagged_note: These came back dangerous, or worth a second look.
report.clean_body: Every link you checked came back clean.
report.empty_body: Check a link and it will show up here.
report.share_message: My Cleanway week: {{checked}} links checked, {{flagged}} marked dangerous. cleanway.ai
report.privacy: This report is built on your phone from the links you checked here. It is not sent anywhere unless you share it.

score.subtitle: You checked links on {{days}} of the last 7 days
score.ring_a11y: You checked links on {{days}} of the last 7 days — {{band}}
score.honesty: This is not a measure of how safe you are. It only counts the days you checked a link in this app.

fact.dangerous_detail: {{num}} of the links you checked this week

score.empty_body: Check your first link, and this becomes a count of the days you check.
score.privacy: Worked out on your phone from your own check history. Nothing is sent anywhere.

settings.sign_in_desc: Keep your settings on all your devices
settings.report_desc: A summary of the links you checked
settings.family_desc: Send alerts to people you care about, end-to-end encrypted
settings.skill_note: Used by the Cleanway browser extension to word its warnings. This app does not change its own wording yet. Saved on this phone, and to your account when you are signed in.
settings.skill_kids_desc: Short, strict warnings, with no button to open a dangerous site anyway.
settings.skill_regular_desc: The default. Clear warnings with a little detail.
settings.skill_granny_desc: Simple words, short sentences, no jargon.
settings.skill_pro_desc: Raw scores, threat types and technical detail.
settings.alerts_note: None of these work yet. Cleanway does not send notifications today, and it never watches your clipboard.
settings.push_desc: Tell me when a link looks dangerous
settings.auto_check_desc: Check a link as soon as I share it to Cleanway
settings.weekly_desc: Send me a summary once a week
settings.clear_confirm_body: This deletes every check saved on this phone. It cannot be undone.
settings.privacy_note: Your check history stays on this phone. When you check a link, only the website name goes to our servers.
settings.sync_failed_body: We couldn't reach your account, so this change won't show on your other devices yet. It will sync next time you change it while online.
settings.clear_done_body: All saved checks were removed from this phone.
settings.clear_failed_body: Something went wrong — your history is unchanged. Please try again.

family.title: Family Hub
family.signed_out_body: Sign in to set up Family Hub. When Cleanway blocks a scam in a family member's browser, you get an alert — end-to-end encrypted, so not even Cleanway can read it.
family.load_failed_body: We couldn't reach our servers, so we can't show your family right now. Your family is still there — please try again.
family.no_family_body: Get an alert when a scam is blocked in a loved one's browser. End-to-end encrypted — even Cleanway can't read the alerts.
family.join_invalid: That invite is not valid or has expired. Codes match upper and lower case exactly — pasting is the safest way.
family.members_load_failed: Couldn't load the member list right now. Pull down or come back later.
family.invite_desc: Makes a one-time code and PIN. Send them by text or read them out. Both appear once — keep them where the other person can read them.
family.alerts_empty: No alerts yet. When Cleanway blocks a scam in a family member's browser, it shows up here.
family.alerts_load_failed: Couldn't load alerts right now. This does not mean there are none — please try again.
family.alerts_undecryptable: {{n}} alert(s) couldn't be read on this phone. They were sent to a key this device doesn't have.
family.modal_title: Share this with your family member
family.modal_desc: Both appear once. After this closes you can't see them again — make another invite if you need to.

auth.sub_login: Sign in to keep your settings on all your devices
auth.sub_register: Free to start — no card needed for an account
auth.sub_reset: We'll email you a link to set a new password
auth.switch_to_register: Don't have an account? Sign up
auth.switch_to_login: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.privacy: With or without an account: we check website names on our servers — never your passwords, messages, or browsing history.
auth.confirm_body: We sent a confirmation link. Open it to activate your account.
auth.reset_sent_body: If an account exists for this address, we've sent a link to reset your password.
auth.generic_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth.not_configured: Sign-in isn't available in this build. You can use everything else without an account.

onboarding.s1_title: Check anything before you tap it
onboarding.s1_desc: Paste a link, scan a QR code, or share anything suspicious straight to Cleanway. You get a plain answer and the reasons behind it.
onboarding.s2_desc: To check a link, only the website name is sent to our servers — never your passwords, messages, or browsing history.
onboarding.s3_desc: On Android, one setup step blocks known scam sites in every app. Brand-new scams can slip past any blocklist — that's what the check button is for.
